name: Tamami
source:
An artificial hybrid of human and cat DNA. She was created using [url=https://vndb.org/c7780]Tomomi's[/url] egg cell and male cat sperm so she is Tomomi's daughter. Tomomi asks Seiichiro to get her pregnant so they can have a nearly identical specimen to study. Because she's half cat she ages quickly.

Her 'favorite number' is 4
